summary: Widen the dynamic HiF4 scale grid from 6 to 20 candidates, all inside the legal E6M2 set (offsets -2..2 x multipliers 1.0/1.25/1.5/1.75). No caller passes a grid, so this reaches q, k and v without bypassing the rotation and smoothing in the parent pipeline. Structure-agnostic, no counterpart, no fitted state.
patches:
CAND_GRID = ((0, 1.0), (0, 1.25), (0, 1.5), (0, 1.75), (1, 1.0), (1, 1.25))
# v647: widen the dynamic scale grid from 6 legal candidates to 20. The old set used offsets
# {0,1} and was even missing (1,1.5) and (1,1.75); the exponent field has room, so scanning
# offsets -2..2 x the four E6M2-legal multipliers {1,1.25,1.5,1.75} stays inside the format.
# No caller passes a grid, so this reaches q, k and v while keeping the rotation and
# smoothing inside the parent pipeline intact.
CAND_GRID = tuple((off, sig) for off in (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
                  for sig in (1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75))
